settings.tagline: Handmade chocolate bouquets, made to order
settings.deliveryAreas: Free delivery across the city. Outstation courier available on request.
settings.orderCutoffNote: Please order at least 2 days ahead. Same-day orders depend on availability — just ask!

faqs.q: How far in advance should I order?
faqs.a: Two days is ideal. For large or fully custom bouquets, three to four days lets us source exactly what you want.

products.name: Ferrero Rocher Bouquet
products.shortDesc: 16 Ferrero Rocher in satin wrap with fairy lights
products.description: Our most-gifted bouquet. Sixteen Ferrero Rocher arranged with artificial roses, wrapped in soft satin and finished with warm fairy lights. Comes with a handwritten gift card.

products.name: Dairy Milk Silk Bouquet
products.shortDesc: 8 Silk bars, pastel wrap, ribbon bow
products.description: Eight full-size Dairy Milk Silk bars in a pastel paper wrap with a hand-tied ribbon. A crowd-pleaser for birthdays.

products.name: KitKat Mini Bouquet
products.shortDesc: Compact 6-bar bouquet — great for a small thank-you
products.description: A smaller, budget-friendly bouquet with six KitKat bars, baby's breath and a kraft paper wrap.

products.name: Money Bouquet
products.shortDesc: Crisp notes folded into roses — you choose the amount
products.description: Currency notes hand-folded into roses and arranged with greenery. You provide the notes, we do the folding. Price shown is for the arrangement only.

products.name: Chocolate & Rose Mix
products.description: A mixed bouquet of assorted chocolates and fresh red roses, wrapped in tissue and brown paper. Roses are sourced the morning of delivery.

products.name: Birthday Special Hamper
products.description: The full package: a chocolate bouquet, a six-inch teddy, a balloon bunch and a handwritten card, boxed together.
